piece.headline: CHERAG TAKES THE TOP SPOT WITH A TRIPLE CAPTAIN BOOST
piece.standfirst: Cherag's Triple Captain lifts him to the top, 4 clear of Ahmad. Justin posted the week's best score and Nihal rocketed up the table.
piece.big_picture: Cherag is top. He took the lead from Ahmad with a Triple Captain week. The gap is only 4, so the lead is thin and Ahmad is right behind. Bhavik is third and still in this.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Maanav and Dinesh left 26 points on the bench. Ravi left 23. 3 managers, 3 teamsheets that needed a second look before the deadline.
piece.one_to_watch: Cherag leads Ahmad by 4 in the title race. One captain choice could flip it. If Cherag's Triple Captain is gone, Ahmad could catch him with a good armband next week.

winners.name: Justin
winners.verdict: Best score of the week. João Pedro wore the armband and Gvardiol came in on cue. Bold calls, and the league has noticed.

winners.name: Cherag
winners.verdict: Played Triple Captain and took the top spot. Rogers came in and worked. Nerve, with 15 points left on the bench.

winners.name: Nihal
winners.verdict: Triple Captain landed and he rocketed 14 places. 3 weeks of grumbling might be done. The chip did its job.

losers.name: Raushan
losers.verdict: Wooden Spoon. Captained Isak for 4, and Calafiori arrived with the rest of the damage. Down 13 places. A shocker.

losers.name: IB
losers.verdict: Isak wore the armband and flopped. Then a big chunk of the squad sat on the bench. The kind of week that gets screenshotted.

losers.name: Maanav
losers.verdict: Wildcard played, new squad built, wrong 11 picked. The bench scored more than it had any right to. Painful viewing.

ratings.l: Bold armband, smart Gvardiol signing, and a big leap up the table. Insufferable now.
